question: With pinned Mistral-7B frozen and the world facts inline, does the v4/v5 latent lattice formed from the model's own final hidden states improve held-out answers through its latent steps: more with four steps than with one at matched parameters?
data_checks: V19 symbolic-oracle labels, affected pattern, label balance and split audit

features.hidden: base.model(...).last_hidden_state at every prompt position (bfloat16): the tensor entering the frozen LM head
features.base_logits: native logits of the two candidates at the last prompt position
features.parity: the frozen head on the captured hidden state reproduces the full native logits bitwise, per row

route.lattice: engine.CausalBroadcastLatentWorkspace (v5), shared weights over latent steps
route.gate: engine gate: LayerNorm and Linear on the base hidden state
route.initialization: per-component derived seeds; arms of one seed share every common parameter

training.objective: choice-normalized cross-entropy over the two candidates at the last prompt position
training.randomness: data order per epoch, dropout and loss sampling per update, all derived from (seed, step)

endpoints.correct: target candidate's adapted logit strictly above the other
endpoints.route_gain: k4 versus base inline (the step-0 logits)
endpoints.test: one-sided exact sign test over world pairs whose 16-row correct count differs
endpoints.verdict_rule: DELIBERATION_STEP_GAIN: route and step gains in all three seeds; LATTICE_GAIN_WITHOUT_STEP_DEPENDENCE: route gain in all three seeds only; otherwise NO_LATTICE_GAIN

descriptive: final accuracy of every arm and seed
truncated inference of four-step arms at one, two and three steps
accuracy by hop distance, affected or unaffected, and wording
repairs and regressions against base inline
content following on affected pairs (both sides right)
gate mean and residual size from the update log
process_policy: each role a fresh process through scripts/run_source_sealed.py, in order, stopping at the first failure
scope: Frozen backbone: bypassing the route restores base inline exactly by construction, so necessity is not a finding here. A step gain would show useful computation over latent steps on this task family only; not memory use, general reasoning, non-regression or language quality.

expected_runtime.extraction: about 7,168 single-row forwards of about 120 tokens plus the base hash; minutes of exclusive GPU
expected_runtime.training: about 2 minutes per arm on CPU at 8 threads (local estimate); 12 arms
expected_runtime.features_bytes_estimate: about 6.6 GiB bfloat16 (859,084 tokens, local tokenizer estimate)
